ref: ADR-0008 "JSON as a source at run time" (a JSON source's queue is a queue like any other); ADR-0006 (context functions are FunCalls over queues, single-value functions a Lift); #98
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. $/lines/sku in its default context, the line, gives a | b | (empty) | c; the context function removeContexts joins them into one context, a, b, c, and the standard function toUpperCase writes A, B, C.
